reviews.author: James Bittick
reviews.text: Had my first session today and extremely impressed. Great operation and team. Most relaxing hour I have had in a while. Feel fantastic and energized, ready to take on the holidays.

reviews.author: Sara Campus
reviews.text: Tomé mi primer sesión ayer, estuvo genial. Muy super atentos; muy limpio todo. Después de la sesión muy relajada, como flotando. Dormí muy bien.

reviews.author: Ken McCleary
reviews.text: The service I received was excellent. My treatment made me feel so much better. I would recommend this service to everyone
